notes: eventType values: 'own-kart' = professional/own-equipment races (the only category Seth's team competes in); 'arrive-and-drive' = rental-fleet races open to general public. motorsportregEventId is MotorsportReg's INTERNAL numeric event ID, confirmed via /rest/events/{id}/entrylist.json — it is NOT the number at the end of the public event URL (that slug ID reliably 404s/'Invalid ID's against the REST API) and isn't shown anywhere on the public event page; get the real ID from MotorsportReg or the event organizer. raceSelectUrl must be a specific event's own '.../EventEntries' page (see the parsing note per event) — a series season-index page like 'raceselect.com/route66/2026' lists rounds but has no entry data itself.

eventTypes.own-kart: Pro / competition event — drivers arrive with their own prepared karts. Setup sheets, tire decisions, and registration intel all apply.
eventTypes.arrive-and-drive: Rental-fleet event — track provides karts. No personal setup data. Scheduling and timing only.
